body_text: PIONEERING AUTONOMOUS CAPABILITIES Top Military Drones Military UAV Manufacturers providing reliable end to end Unmanned Aircraft System solution that gives you the edge where when it matters most View Products To shape the future battlefield, the defence sector is heavily reliant on the transformation of digital technology. Keeping pace with industry-driven changes and challenges, ADASI is committed to giving you the edge, from unmanned systems to AI-enabled drones, whenever and wherever. As a trustworthy end-to-end solution provider, ADASI has extensive and robust knowledge of the autonomous systems industry. Founded in 2007, ADASI aims to not only enhance and strengthen its customers’ technological capabilities but also design unmanned systems that help customers to navigate challenging and demanding tasks. In our area of specialty, we have witnessed several modernisations in the defence sector. The world at large has embraced the use and production of autonomous and unmanned drones. ADASI is at the forefront of ensuring that every part of the world is ready to accept and acquire these changes in terms of warfare advancements and air mobility. As part of the EDGE group, we acquire, develop, test, operate, and maintain state-of-the-art systems for air, land, and sea. Focused on building a new generation of autonomous capability, we modify and reconfigure performance to align with our client’s strategic and tactical goals as well as their technological capabilities. Providing both frontline and back-end support, we help our clients by offering products, systems, subsystems, designs, development, testing, commissioning, maintenance and many more solutions to meet their needs. PROCURING OPERATIONAL SERVICES Are you concerned about your operational requirements for both the control station and air vehicles? Consider it solved when you choose ADASI. The future of combat is unmanned and we are equipped to provide state-of-the-art solutions, joint analysis on your mission objectives, meticulous equipment selection, and procurement. We analyse all of your requirements to accurately develop and state an integrated solution including military UAV, UAV sensors, transportation, mobile ground stations, and workshops. We pay close attention to your operational needs, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), and other necessities to offer you the best-in-class solutions for your needs. With ADASI, you are one step ahead at all times. A TACTICAL AND HOLISTIC APPROACH Due to an excellent rapport with our OEM suppliers and exceptional engineering expertise, we are professionals in payload integration and development of systems, including the interface with complex technologies such as command, control, communication, computer, and intelligence (C4I). Working closely with a talented pool of personnel on-ground to help you achieve your goals is part of our holistic approach. Right from taking care of flight operations to maintenance and logistics – ADASI covers it all. Being one of the top military UAV, UGV & USV manufacturers and unmanned vehicle companies in UAE, our highly skilled team bags years of experience and comprises industry experts; ADASI can provide its customers with the right fit of support staff to help you seamlessly deploy unmanned systems. With the help of our advanced OEM relationships, we boast a vast inventory of spare parts, ensuring we are readily available for any maintenance work and full logistical support. We are capable of establishing a dedicated maintenance operation team on-site to enable fast and efficient maintenance. UNMANNED READINESS FOR LAND, AIR AND SEA At ADASI, we deliver next-generation unmanned systems through extensive industry knowledge, in-house research & development and leading international partnerships. These systems are designed to work under extreme conditions and perform critical functions such as monitoring and surveillance. Despite the constant technological changes, ADASI is a strategic unmanned system manufacturer, aiming for consistent innovation, integration, and deployment of key products. GARMOOSHA A light unmanned aircraft system (UAS) Garmoosha curated to carry payloads of approximately 100 kg with an endurance of six hours and a range of 150km. With a Ground Control Station (GCS), this helicopter is designed for surveillance purposes on a low-consumption fuel engine, giving militaries the liberty to allocate their manned helicopters for critical missions. AEROSTAT SYSTEM 200/300/400 Offering novel deployment options for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) missions, and C4I systems, AEROSTAT has an endurance that lasts for weeks and can carry electro-optical/ infrared (EO/IR) sensors up to 1,500ft above sea level. Providing supreme flexibility at a low or no-vibration platform for even the most sensitive of systems, AEROSTAT is the best fit for large-sized payloads and ground-based surveillance. AL SABR S-100 We have been operating and providing after-sales support to AL SABR systems for over a decade. AL SABR systems are fully autonomous allowing live video, vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) capabilities with an airborne endurance of up to ten hours; this also includes honing skills, training pilots, and deploying Al Sabr UAV in daily operations from systems and payloads to maintenance and logistics. With a longer range and endurance, AL SABR acts as a transponder for a wide range of altitudes. It enables various deployment possibilities with flexible data dissemination capabilities, from remote video terminals to C4I networking, making it an ideal platform for all types of operations. QX-1, QX-2, QX-3 LOITERING MUNITIONS The QX range of loitering munitions ensure a powerful aerial capability in the hands of frontline forces and provide the optimal tools for military forces to make accurate and discreet attacks with various payload capacities. These drones are quick to deploy, the smaller of which can be carried in a backpack, feature onboard video feeds in real-time as well as multiple fuse options.

body_text: BEYOND SHIPBUILDING ADSB specialises in the build, repair, maintenance, refit, and conversion of naval and commercial Ships. With 25 years of service to the UAE and beyond, we are one of the most experienced shipyards building company. We deploy the latest technologies, including robotics, to maximise fleet readiness, extend ship lifetimes, and lower overall lifecycle costs. Developing advanced maritime capabilities is essential for national sovereignty and economic prosperity. Abu Dhabi Ship Building (ADSB) is the regional leader in the design, new build, repair, maintenance, refit and conversion of naval and commercial vessels, helping keep the GCC’s naval fleet in prime operational condition. In the offshore oil & gas sector, we provide fabrication, maintenance, and refurbishment services. We operate one of the most experienced shipyards in the region and have served our customers for over 25 years. Leveraging the latest technologies and solutions , we maximise fleet readiness and extend ship lifetimes while lowering overall cost. We design and build highly complex vessels for both naval and commercial customers. We have the technical and operational expertise to service vessels of all sizes, whether they are involved in littoral warfare operations, patrol missions, or exclusive economic zone protection. ADSB is a part of the Platforms & Systems cluster at EDGE. Our statement of purpose is to be the region’s leading naval & commercial shipyard, offering unmatched service, innovation and skill. View website NAVAL AND COMMERCIAL SHIPYARDS At ADSB, we are a leader in the fabrication of naval vessels operating three major naval programmes: corvettes, offshore patrol vessels, and fast patrol boats, including the region’s largest naval shipbuilding programme for the UAE Navy’s six Baynunah class corvettes and Falaj offshore patrol vessels. We offer a comprehensive range of at-sea and dry dock maintenance and repairs, upgrade and conversions, engineering consultancy, and shipyard services to both our commercial and naval clients. ENSURING NAVAL READINESS DESIGN ADSB has reinforced its in-house design capabilities to provide customised solutions that meet customers’ requirements and expectations. We have a diverse portfolio of fast patrol boat types and lengths already proven and in the water. NAVAL PRODUCTS SMALL BOATS ADSB has developed a range of fast patrol boats and interceptors entirely designed and built in the UAE. These include 120 FIP (fast interceptor platform), 160 ITEP and 170 ITEP (inshore tactical and engagement platforms). Other products also include an 8.5m special mission boat, assault boats, as well as a wide range of landing craft and sea keepers. LARGE BOATS CORVETTES Featuring the latest new corvette designs, the Baynunah class corvette is a multipurpose warship that can be used for a range of missions, including coastal patrol, reconnaissance, mine detection, and helicopter operations - all with a modern weaponry and sensor packages. OFFSHORE PATROL VESSELS ADSB offers offshore patrol vessels that are specifically developed for navies to conduct a wide variety of tasks. Based on the proven ‘Fearless-class’ platform, FALAJ-3 is designed and equipped for advanced naval duties and is well-equipped to to tackle the challenges of modern day asymmetric warfare. PATROL VESSELS Designed to a wide range of operations, ADSB’s 36FLEX provides a versatile platform to meet all your maritime defence, surveillance, law enforcement, and search-and-rescue requirements to secure your territorial waters. NAVAL SERVICES MAINTENANCE SERVICES ADSB, one of the leading ship building companies in the UAE, provides maintenance and repair services for maritime security naval platforms operating in the region as well as midlife, major and navigational refits, dry docking, and MTU engine overhauling. We maintain and repair naval ships in compliance with stringent standards and specifications. We assure that all processes and products are reviewed regularly in order to consistently improve our offerings. Certified by Bureau Veritas Certification, we have an ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, and Safety Management certifications. SUSTAINMENT Our sustainment services enable our clients to concentrate on their mission or commercial activity, leaving our team to handle all maintenance functions. Through our in-service support, we provide basic maintenance while vessels are in service, complemented by the guaranteed availability of long-lead time spare parts and equipment. As a result, vessels are available and maintenance windows are shorter. WAREHOUSING FACILITIES A shipyard warehouse provides a safe location to store all critical materials for a project and stock items used for daily operations. At ADSB, we operate four warehouses, six open spaces and satellite stores to enable storage and distribution at project sites and ensure prompt execution of each project. These units are controlled through a highly organised stock control system. COMBAT SYSTEMS INTEGRATION (CSI) We provide a complete range of combat military system (CMS) installation and integration services in conjunction with the Abu Dhabi System Integration Company. Our services range from designing and engineering to installation and commissioning. It includes OEM combat systems such as sensors, effectors, and weapons. ENSURING COMMERCIAL READINESS COMMERCIAL PRODUCT LANDING CRAFT ADSB offers a wide range of landing craft that are designed to support a variety of offshore and coastal activities. ADSB’s landing craft are specifically constructed to support the surface ship-to-shore movement of personnel, cargo, and vehicles. ADSB’s SEA platforms, SEA PAD and SEA TROOPER, deliver operational efficiencies and simplified logistics, maintenance and repair. SEA TROOPER meets diverse transport requirements, while the SEA PAD supports inshore ISR operations. PATROL VESSELS Designed to high quality commercial standards, ADSB’s 36FLEX is equipped to conduct a wide range of maritime operations, such as monitoring shipping, boarding operations and carrying out patrol duties COMMERCIAL SERVICES MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS We have completed complex projects on various types of commercial ships from conversions to dry docking, including offshore supply vessels, diving support vessels, and superyachts. With more than two decades of experience in commercial boat repairs and services, we have built world-class expertise in this field. YARD SERVICES The services we offer include boat docking and undocking, yard-cleaning, and garbage disposal. We offer comprehensive yard services supported by experts in rigging, diving, and yard-cleaning. Additionally, we maintain ready-to-use mobile equipment such as forklifts, shuttle lifts, and mobile cranes. OFFSHORE RIG FABRICATION As specialists in rig and platform maintenance and refurbishment, we have an extensive network of industry alliances with API- and ASME-certified partners. We also offer topside fabrication for offshore oil and gas and provide steel fabrication support for offshore EPCIs and energy companies. SHIPBUILDING CAPABILITIES ADSB's dedicated steel and aluminium fabrication shops are equipped with advanced machinery and technologies, and are supported by a highly qualified team. We handle everything from major repairs to the design and construction of modular units with the latest 3D modelling. Our mechanical shop features sophisticated machines, cranes, and a clean, controlled environment. Our highly skilled machinists, millwrights, and mechanical fitters provide repair, refurbishment, and maintenance services, ensuring rapid turnaround, quality, and efficiency. Our Small Boat Construction (SBC) division manufactures landing crafts, fast patrol boats, interceptors, and immediate support vessels for customers in the GCC and beyond. Our piping workshop offers services such as profile cutting, pipe bending and fitting, and welding procedures. We leverage the latest automated equipment for indoor prefabrication before installation into vessels. Furthermore, the electrical workshop at ADSB offers comprehensive services, including troubleshooting and repair of motors and generators, lighting systems, power systems, switchboards, control systems and panels. Our carpentry, sheet metal and insulation shops are fully equipped to manage high quality maritime outfitting for minor alterations to major upgrades. Our services also include a wide range of hull treatments and tank coatings, as well as surface preparation and painting of underwater surfaces, main decks, engine rooms, funnels, masts, and chain lockers, anchors and chains. CONVERSIONS With our extensive knowledge in ship building and repair, ADSB offers design, engineering, manufacturing, and implementation of any ship conversion project. We handle projects of all sizes and types for both military and commercial clients at our BV, LR, DNV-GL, RINA, TASNEEF and ISO certified facilities and state-of-the-art shipyard. Our customers benefit from our exceptional quality, timely delivery, and cost-effective pricing on everything from modifications, refits and upgrades to complete structural redesigns and transformations.

Across space, air, ground, sea, and subsea domains, sensors are essential for effective offensive and defensive capabilities, as well as for a wide range of civilian data and monitoring applications. Our Advanced Sensing cluster strengthens UAE-sovereign capabilities in electro-optics and radar, including signal processing and sensor fusion technologies, across the electromagnetic spectrum. body_text: THE GREATEST RISK IS COMPLACENCY View Products In the face of constant change, we must quickly adapt how we operate to reflect this reality. At BEACON RED, we confront national security challenges in unconventional ways. Founded in 2018, BEACON RED is a wholly owned subsidiary in the Space & Cyber Technologies within EDGE Group. When it comes to defence, our goal is always the same. We aim to enhance the capabilities of national security agencies and personnel to face the contemporary challenges of today and tomorrow, wherever they might be found. At BEACON RED, we develop novel approaches to the world’s most challenging problems. Our team comprises of elite professionals, hand-picked from 25 different countries. We are thought leaders, innovators, and risk takers from the world's most prestigious organisations and businesses. We are pioneers, who constantly push the boundaries of the status quo. Our subject matter expertise is not just extensive but also innovative, combining advances in knowledge management, people analytics, project delivery, language support services, and group security. Through our extensive course catalog of almost 100 training solutions and assessment platforms, we guarantee that the next generation of national security professionals are prepared to succeed in any location, environment, or situation on the globe. Each training solution we develop is flexible, relevant, and representative of the challenges that our students will confront in the 21st century. These solutions are also capable of accommodating the constraints of any security culture as we recognise the difficulties inherent in working at a national security establishment. Through close collaborations with our partners and clients, we guarantee that their strategic needs and the capabilities necessary for success in any national security context are completely aligned. We offer only the most bold and audacious training, skills, and technologies to motivate and push our partners and clients to be transformative, adaptable, and flexible in any situation, anywhere in the world. THE SCIENCE OF SELECTION Trusting in the science of selection, our people analytics division is always on the lookout for professionals to contribute to the dynamic nature of national security. Our team of statisticians, data scientists, and applied psychologists leverage cutting-edge analytical testing with psychometric and biometric measures to simplify and streamline a client’s selection process. With our bespoke battery of precision testing and real-time personality characteristic mapping, our clients can effectively meet their performance objectives and identify the profile they need to maximise talent, human performance, and mental resilience. At BEACON RED, we utilise supervised machine learning for the analysis of numerous data points, ensuring the selection of only the best and most competent applicants. People analytics equips decision and policymakers with the information necessary to inspire dynamic performance throughout an organisation. EDUCATING TOMORROW’S SECURITY PROFESSIONALS The next generation of security professionals will confront enormous difficulties in a fast-changing asymmetric security environment. Recognising this issue, BEACON RED believes that the best way to prepare is to create training solutions that spark not only curiosity but also thorough understanding of the UAE's national security establishment. This is exactly what our knowledge management team is here for. Banding together a broad group of subject matter experts, our team develops the most relevant and current national security agency training platforms and curriculums for our trainees. We design our training solutions to be flexible and responsive in order to meet our clients’ strategic requirements, regardless of their location. These solutions also adhere to the SAT (Systems Approach to Training) standard and come complete with comprehensive training and technical documentation. Beyond training materials, we provide our students with the basic and advanced skills, along with opportunities to succeed in the classroom, to prepare them for the difficulties they will encounter in the real world. POWER IN OUR PEOPLE At BEACON RED, we not only develop high-quality training solutions for the next generation of national security professionals but also oversee the implementation and execution of up to one hundred unique programmes. Comprised of experts and instructors from industry-leading agencies and organisations across the globe, our project delivery team boasts an extensive subject matter expertise necessary to succeed in any contemporary national security establishment. In collaboration with the UAE government, we equip our graduates with competitive knowledge and skills that prepares them to confront and address the long-term strategic implications of national security. EXPERT LANGUAGE SUPPORT Bridging the cultural divide between our instructors and students, our linguists and interpreters are more than just translators; they are creators and facilitators. At BEACON RED, we integrate a team of 75 full-time English-to-Arabic language assistance specialists into all areas of our work, all of whom ensure that our translations are culturally and contextually appropriate for the organisation or environment in which they will be deployed. This is especially true when operating in areas of national security, where we allow no room for interpretation. With our readiness to meet any translation requirement, we can equip organisations, institutions, and government agencies with the language support services they need in engaging in the development of public and private sector initiatives. Additionally, we provide discrete legal translation services across the UAE for businesses operating in sensitive areas. BUILDING CULTURES OF RISK MANAGEMENT In an increasingly complex region, BEACON RED prioritises the safety and welfare of employees, as well as our clients and partner organisations. We aim to build risk management cultures from the inside out through the successful integration of specialist advisers that adapt into any organisational structure. We are aware that threats tend to occur in the most unexpected of places and at the most inconvenient of times. This is why we deploy an active operational security staff available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, protecting all of our project departments and locations with the best quality threat assessments, risk mitigations, and group security innovations. Equipped with vast experience in performing assessments, audits, and investigations, our team of enterprise risk managers are well-versed in establishing supporting policies and procedures for some of the world's largest businesses in the most challenging regions.

name: HITTING THE MARK
description: Discover Caracal's high-performance small arms and firearms. We provide world-class precision weapons for defense and law enforcement across the globe.
body_text: HITTING THE MARK We are world-renowned small arms manufacturer. With being in the weapons industry from past 15 years, we have established ourselves as pioneers in building high-precision weapons and guns. View Products CARACAL is an internationally recognised small-arms manufacturer with a production legacy of over 15 years in designing, engineering, manufacturing, and assembling high-precision, battlefield-proven firearms. CARACAL, headquartered in Abu Dhabi, is a part of EDGE Group's Missiles & Weapon cluster. The company's product line consists of combat pistols, submachine guns, assault rifles, and sniper rifles in a variety of calibres. CARACAL utilises the highest quality CNC machines, quality control equipment, and moulding technologies to construct is firearms at leading edge facilities. PRODUCTS CARACAL, a leading small-arms manufacturer company in UAE, has a wide range of pistols, submachine guns, assault rifles and sniper rifles that are field-tested to provide the most reliable arms for law enforcement, security, and military forces, and can also be used as personal defence weapons. Our products are continuously monitored for compliance with international standards such as NATO and CIP. PISTOLS CARACAL EF – HIGHLY VERSATILE STRIKER FIRED PISTOL The 9x19mm CARACAL Enhanced F pistol was released in 2015. There has been extensive testing of this weapon under the harshest conditions to ensure it meets standards. It also features an 18-round 9mm magazine of high capacity, and retains the low bore axis of previous CARACAL pistols. The CARACAL Enhanced F pistol features an optional threaded barrel available for attaching suppressors, and a propriety two-dot sight system with the capability to use a quick-sight combat system. CARACAL F GEN II – HIGHLY VERSATILE SEMI-AUTOMATIC PISTOL To deliver the best pistol to the end user, CARACAL F GEN II underwent a rigorous development process. To meet internationally recognised standards, Gen F II was thoroughly tested under harsh conditions. Carrying an 18-round magazine, it retains the unique low bore axis of previous CARACAL pistols. This pistol features interchangeable solid sights, a low profile slide that allows the operator to feel less recoil, and an integrated Mil-spec picatinny rail (MIL-STD-1913) to attach multiple accessories for a smooth and crisp trigger performance. SUBMACHINE GUNS CARACAL CMP9 SMG – MODERN SUBMACHINE GUN A modern and modular weapon, the CMP9 SMG features an advanced blowback system and a 9x19mm calibre munitions. The bolt extends over the barrel to provide better weapon control and weight distribution, with an ambidextrous charging handle and a traditional pistol grip for firing. ASSAULT RIFLES CAR 814 – TACTICAL RIFLE FOR STRATEGIC SUCCESS Featuring NATO 5.56x45mm cartridges, the CAR 814 is a centre-firing, direct gas-impingement operated assault rifle used in law enforcement and military settings. This weapon is available in both semi-automatic and select-fire configurations, and in a variety of barrel lengths. CAR 816 – TACTICAL RIFLE FOR STRATEGIC SUCCESS The CAR 816 is an advanced tactical weapon that is intended for law enforcement and military applications. This assault rifle is a centre-fired, gas powered, NATO 5.56x45mm rifle and operates on a short-stroke piston system with three settings. Depending on preferences, the weapon can be configured to either semi-automatic or select-fire model. CAR 817 AR – ADVANCED ARM, ACCURATE STRIKES A centre-firing, gas-operated, rotating bolt, the CAR 817 AR rifle is chambered in 7.62x51 mm NATO (.308 WIN). A short-stroke push-rod gas piston system regulates the system's operation. Assembled with fully ambidextrous functionality, the weapon is available in both semi-automatic and select-fire configurations. SNIPER RIFLES CSR 308 – RUGGED PRECISION RIFLE The CSR 308 rifle is a modern, rugged, accurate, manual-bolt rifle weapon that can withstand the most demanding environments. The CSR 308 offers reliability, safety, and ease of operation for military and law enforcement personnel. CSA 338 – SEMI-AUTOMATIC SNIPER RIFLE (optional) The 338 Lapua Magnum is a semi-automatic precision platform that not only produces the accuracy of a bolt action sniper, but also allows for quick follow-up shots, which can make all the difference between mission success and failure. Built from scratch to meet the most stringent needs of Special Forces, the CSA 338 provides dependable operation in even the most extreme of environments. CSR 338 – MODERN PRECISION RIFLE (optional) The CSR 338 is a modern, robust, manual-bolt, precision rifle system designed for challenging environments. Featuring a sophisticated design, a superior level of craftsmanship, and high-quality materials, this rifle supports excellent accuracy, reliability, and durability. The CSR 338 is suitable for military and law enforcement personnel. CAR 817 DMR – HIGH-PRECISION TACTICAL ARM The CAR 817 DMR (Designated Marksmen Rifle) offers high-precision, semi-automatic, gas-operated, rotating bolt system tactical accuracy chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO (.308 Win). It is a tactical weapon used by law enforcement and the military. The weapon is only available in semi-automatic. CSR 50 – BOLT-ACTION PRECISION RIFLE In order to engage long-range targets, the CSR 50 is a bolt-action precision rifle equipped with the 12.7x99mm NATO cartridge. This lightweight match-grade rifle boasts a solid, monolithic aluminium receiver and a free-floating, heavy-contour barrel that ensures an unprecedented degree of accuracy. A COMMITMENT TO SUPPORT We are able to design and develop in-house products by merging ergonomics with tactical requirements of our clients. Our work demands the inclusion of disruptive technologies, autonomy, directed energy, and quantum computing, which our team of dedicated professionals helps achieve. In addition to offering our clients full technical assistance in maintaining and repairing weapon systems, we also provide basic to advanced training for armour and operators. Advanced technologies, such as additive manufacturing and CAD/CAM, enable us to continually enhance our products, providing superior performance and durability while meeting the evolving needs of our customers. We upgrade our weapons on a regular basis to ensure that they meet our customers' changing mission needs. As a result, our products deliver the firepower required for troops to effectively accomplish their missions. GROWTH ABROAD CARACAL has excelled in its pursuit of long-term profitability and fostering strategic relationships with stakeholders under the leadership of Hamad Alameri, CEO of CARACAL. Our relationship with our stakeholders and industry partners is based on transparency and trust to maintain strong working relationships and help ensure smooth operations. As a result of the international success of CARACAL weapons, there have been wholly-owned subsidiaries and joint ventures established in major markets. These companies reproduce CARACAL weapons, meeting local requirements. CARACAL USA CARACAL USA firearms range feature high-quality components, materials and testing procedures. These weapons provide reliability, durability, accuracy and impeccable performance even under the most extreme conditions. MERKEL As a leader in the production of hunting rifles in Europe, Merkel has more than 120 years of global expertise. The company combines advanced technological and time-tested manufacturing processes to produce all the important components of a gun. Merkel’s rigorous ballistic tests and quality control assures full precision. HAENEL Haenel has a team of world-class engineers, weapons technicians, and gunsmiths. Under the highest quality standards, the company manufactures key components such as barrels, closures, and lock bolts that ensure exceptional performance in every facet.

description: EPI provides world-class precision engineering and machining solutions for the aerospace, defense, and oil and gas industries.
body_text: TOTAL PRECISION. TOTAL CONTROL EPI is a key contributor of precision engineering to global Aerospace, Defence, and Oil & Gas industries. We provide solutions with industry-specific standards and our focus is on building precision manufacturing infrastructure. View Products Since its formation in 2007, EPI has been dedicated to manufacturing top-of-the-line complex engineered components. As a precision engineering company in the UAE, we continuously serve as the engineering backbone of the country's expanding defence and aerospace industries, as well as a key contributor to the oil and gas sectors. We support small arms manufacturing, and over the years, we gradually grew into one of the GCC’s leading precision engineering companies dedicated to the aerospace, defence, and oil and gas industries. At EPI, we transform initial designs to finished components through our comprehensive range of specialised technical services. These standard-driven precision engineering services cover engineering, machining, special processes, laboratories, and inspection, all of which are performed in our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Abu Dhabi. Each of our precision engineering solutions is evaluated against industry-specific benchmarks and developed to satisfy stringent international quality standards. Today, we provide design enhancements and modifications in addition to manufacturing components. We re-engineer completed designs and existing components, all while maintaining a high level of quality and precision throughout the process. As part of EDGE in the EDGE Commercial cluster, EPI is committed to harnessing only the latest and most relevant technologies. We have evolved from our first four machines to an integrated suite of no less than 100 advanced machine and system tools, including the revolutionary CNC milling, CNC turning, chemical processing, non-destructive testing, shot peening, PVD coating, and plastic injection. Along with cutting-edge technology, we invest in the brightest brains in the industry. Our Industrial Engineers are trained to transform concepts into functional prototypes using precision engineering machine tools and a state-of-the-art measurement facility that ensures accuracy. With the best people and technology in the field, we are able to impart our expertise in all stages of the manufacturing process. In 2011, EPI was the first firm in the Gulf region to receive the EN/AS9100 Revision C accreditation, known as the aerospace industry's premier Quality Management System. We have also been certified as an ISO 9001:2015 company. With our strategic alliances with major worldwide companies, we have an advantage over other industry players, enabling us to strengthen our supply chains, skills, and experience, as well as develop new precision engineering solutions at our state-of-the-art facility. This also allows us to continue our commitment to deliver high-quality precision engineering services to market-leading regional and worldwide clients, including some of the world's largest aviation, defense, and oil & gas OEMs. CUTTING-EDGE MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING & MACHINING At EPI, we assist with product development throughout all stages, from early capacity assessments and prototyping all the way to final manufacturing and process design. These 21st century precision engineering solutions are made possible with our state-of-the-art machinery and competent team of CAD/CAM designers, programmers, tool makers, and application and manufacturing engineers. Included in our manufacturing engineering solutions are process capability studies, precision machining, prototyping, CAD/CAM programming, application engineering, manufacturing process design, and production process development. Meanwhile, our machining capabilities cover the following services: three-and five-axis milling machining soft and hard materials; turning; EDM, grinding; plastic injections; laser and TIG welding; rectification processes (three-point bending, roll forming, shot peening by ultrasonic and blasting); and assembly for faster installation, torqueing, bushing, and bearing installation, all of which are tailored to satisfy the most stringent industry standards. QUALITY AND PRECISION AT EVERY STEP EPI features a new surface treatment facility with an approximate 8000 square metre footprint, custom-built to accommodate a broad variety of special procedures and finishes. This facility comes complete with equipment capable of carrying out the following precision engineering services: Chemical cleaning on Al, Ti Anodizing (SAA, HAA, CAA, TSAA, BSAA) and Alodine Passivation Phosphating NDT (Penetrant Testing) Painting (water and solvent borne) and ink marking PDV coating Chemical analysis capability testing Titration pH Hydrogen determination Conductivity ICP Surface improvement using blasting, vibro polishing, shot peening Paint stripping by media plastic Carburising Plasma nitriding Tempering and annealing Process monitoring/performance evaluation Climate chamber Salt-spray chamber Paint adhesion testing HARNESSING LEADING-EDGE TECH From our cutting tools center equipped with advanced precision engineering technology, we manufacture cutting tools and re-sharpeners that are guaranteed to be of the highest quality and precision and ideal for a variety of operations, including milling, drilling, and reaming, among other things. On top of measuring and inspection of cutting tools, we provide custom-made cutting tools for all applications, five-axis cutter grinders for tool re-sharpening, self-measurement probes and 3D simulators, and manufacturing and re-sharpening services for carbide and HSS tools. Through our established Physical Vapour Deposition coating process, we provide a variety of standard and bespoke coatings. These top-of-the-line coating services enable our clients to maximize the life and performance of their equipment. INSPECTION AND LABORATORIES DRIVEN BY STANDARDS Continually monitoring and controlling all our products and production processes, our expert team guarantees that our precision engineering solutions satisfactorily fulfill our internal and external client requirements. That is why at EPI, we zero in on training our staff to get operator credentials and participate in reassessment programs, enabling us to increase the number of self-inspection deployments across departments. Our Statistical Process Control framework takes this a step further by optimizing sample techniques and redefining critical features necessary for compliance with our Quality Policy. Our inspection process is carried out using traditional inspection equipment, such as vernier calipers, micrometers, digital high-gage measuring equipment, Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM), and hexagon machines equipped with PCDMIS for offline programming. Metallic Laboratory To achieve industrial standards, we are prepared to regulate the characteristics of materials, such as multiple aluminum grades, titanium, steel, and stainless steel. images.alt: SIGN4L UAE - Electronic Warfare Intelligence Solutions

body_text: CRITICAL DEFENCE, OPERATIONAL CONFIDENCE SIGN4L is the leading provider of electronic warfare and intelligence solutions in the UAE. We develop solutions for defence and security forces in Integrated electronic warfare technologies, Aircraft electronic survivability systems, Intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) sensors View Products Electronic warfare (EW) technologies are rapidly establishing themselves as critical components in the modern battlespace. Providing defence and security forces with cutting-edge capabilities, SIGN4L enables its clients to achieve superiority in the electromagnetic (EM) spectrum throughout their military and intelligence missions. Part of the Electronic Warfare & Intelligence (EW&I) cluster within EDGE, SIGN4L is the UAE-based leader in developing such solutions and one of the few in the region. We enable our clients to confidently defend and control the EM spectrum and degrade their opponents' EM capacity, ensuring mission success. SIGN4L pioneers sophisticated and innovative technology and provides clients with customised procurement, configuration, deployment, and servicing capabilities for their unique organisational and operational requirements. From electronic camouflage and concealment to guaranteeing electronic clarity across platforms, our solutions cover a broad range of EW systems suitable for active defence, offence, and situational awareness purposes. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, we develop flexible, adaptive, and dependable EW&I technologies. In addition, we provide lifecycle support in three primary areas: integrated electronic warfare solutions; aircraft electronic survivability systems; and intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition, and reconnaissance (ISTAR) sensors for maintaining battle-space awareness and superiority. SUPERIORITY ACROSS THE SPECTRUM As one of the leading EW solutions providers in UAE, SIGN4L supplies EM or directed energy weapons for degrading, disrupting, or rejecting the opposing troops' communications, targeting, and navigation. These electronic attack technologies involve threat analysis and response, along with countermeasures such as radio frequency (RF) weapons, spoofing, lasers, signal jamming, and any combination thereof to successfully neutralise the threat. Our EW solutions can be used to conceal or spoof the position of troops and safeguard personnel, platforms, and assets against RF-equipped explosive devices. V-PROTECT RF COMMUNICATION JAMMING SYSTEM V-Protect is a state-of-the-art mobile active and reactive high-power jamming system, enabling blocking of all common terrestrial radio frequency (RF) signal technologies as well as portable SATCOM equipment. Due to ever-evolving global threats, SIGN4L has developed leading-edge technologies to counter RF controlled devices. Designed and built in the UAE, V-Protect provides seamless and adaptable protection across relevant frequency bands and technologies. Fitted onto a standard SUV, the system is rapidly deployable and efficiently operated for a multirole applications. DISABLING ATTACKS, SECURING DEFENCE As one of the top EW solutions providers, SIGN4L develops systems to support the electronic protection of a country’s personnel and equipment while ensuring tactical and strategic decision-making. These systems include technologies for target acquisition, high accuracy warning systems, and state-of-the-art countermeasure systems. To protect client targeting, navigation, and communication systems from hostile threats, we deliver solutions that strengthen both offensive target acquisition and incoming warning systems. These technologies are especially effective at stopping radar or other sensors from jamming and facilitating a smooth transfer to secure, unjammed frequencies. Additionally, our systems include electronic and thermal defences against incoming threats, such as heat-seeking missiles. NAVCONTROL-G NavControl-G is a sophisticated spoofing system that emits counterfeit GPS signals that mimic legitimate ones in order to generate an alternative path and safely mitigate the threat of hostile UAVs. Designed and built in the UAE, NavControl-G takes control of target UAVs, safeguarding sensitive and protected areas. Encased in a shock-proof container, the system can be seamlessly integrated across multiple configurations - either in fixed locations or rapidly deployed on the field when required. RELIABLE ELECTRONIC SUPPORT SIGN4L's broad portfolio of radar and EW systems helps clients successfully detect, identify, and track EM energy sources, enhancing their understanding of operational forces and assets in the battle area. Thus, troops can spot threats, collect data, and plan for future operations. To provide clients with this situational awareness capability, SIGN4L incorporated electronic intelligence assets (passive and active radar) and communication intelligence assets (GSM, UHF, and VHF radios and electro-optical and infrared sensors) into their radar systems. UNRIVALLED INTELLIGENCE As technologies in the EM space constantly evolve, defence and security forces have to tackle emerging threats and navigate a world of ever-changing requirements and risks. That is why research and innovation is fundamental to how we stay ahead of of the adversary and at the forefront of new opportunities. In a progressively complex environment, SIGN4L continues to create EW&I solutions that deliver the highest levels of protection, information dominance, and situational awareness. Our sophisticated methods and integrated technologies ensure that government legal interception and homeland security organisations have an edge over their competitors. With research at the heart of its service, SIGN4L guarantees that its clients can take advantage of the most innovative and advanced EW systems on the market. Our staff is unmatched in terms of developing cutting-edge technology and continuously delivering support and capabilities across numerous military platforms when and where it’s required. DEVELOPING NEXT GENERATION ELECTRONIC WARFARE At SIGN4L, we formulated a rigorous and disciplined cycle of research and development for the efficient monitoring, analysis, and mitigation of emerging hazards. Our engineering and development teams specialise in sophisticated RF digital sensors, RF propagation, RF signal processing, threat detection and warning, and secure communications in disputed settings. Additionally, we evaluate possibilities for our clients in the development of converged, multi-role systems, to allow for the overlapping domains of cyber and electronic warfare. By establishing and maintaining outstanding connections with leading global technology providers, we guarantee that our clients have access to the most leading-edge technologies and solutions.

body_text: TECHNOLOGIES & INDUSTRIALISATION Accelerating innovation in cutting-edge sovereign capabilities The Technologies & Industrialisation cluster delivers tailored, high-impact solutions to strategic end users. name: XRANGE
description: Discover XRANGE, the premier multi-domain testing and evaluation facility. We offer advanced air, land, and sea trials to perfect your defense systems.
body_text: XRANGE XRANGE is a state-of-the-art, multi-domain training, testing and evaluation range to perfect performance of platforms, systems and personnel. Advanced Testing. Perfected Performance. XRANGE is the region’s only state-of-the-art, multi-domain training, testing and evaluation range. XRANGE brings sophisticated, flexible, multi-domain training, testing and evaluation (TT&E) capabilities to the heart of the Middle East, Africa, and Central and South Asia region. Commercial and military customers can conduct complex, air, ground and maritime trials in a safe, secure and instrumented environment. Conventional munitions, such as bombs and rockets, and electronic warfare lasers and signal jamming can be tested with cutting-edge, high-precision, video and data acquisition systems. These are aided by multiple asset surveillance and tracking technologies, and advanced hemispheric tracking radars. For electronic warfare, passive RF monitoring creates a known RF environment to facilitate the scientific testing of these systems. We offer a comprehensive range of testing and training opportunities: Air testing Land testing Maritime testing Electronic warfare testing Environmental testing Close-quarters training View website Our Services Testing and evaluation trials planning services Trials range area provision Small arms-ranges consultancy Testing and evaluation instrumentation Pan-domain platform trials Range management and operations Turnkey testing and evaluation-range services support Testing and evaluation systems and infrastructure The Island RANGE is located on a highly secure, uninhabited island approximately 8km off the Abu Dhabi coastline and a 100km drive from Abu Dhabi city. The island is 35km by 15km, enabling a land danger area of 355km2, inclusive of a 3.8-km-long, 60-metre-wide runway. The air danger area is permanently closed to 8,000ft and can be extended to 40,000ft. A 50km2 sea danger area enables shallow- and deep-water testing, training and rehearsal. Operational year round and ideal for hot weather trials due to its arid, humid and dusty environment, the fully functional runway and on-island customs clearance mean customers can fly directly into and out of XRANGE, simplifying logistics.
